mission.posting: A valuable client of our group has requested he deletion of a file on previous employee's private computer. The files are not unique, and the company merely wishes to remove this individual's copy. The target is unlikely to mount a passive trace against you.

email.subject: Cleaning up loose ends 2 - NEEDS EDITING
email.body:
Greetings Agent,
An employee in our company recently left us to work for a competitor. In doing so, he took a large volume of internal data from our company with him, and it would be unfortunate for us if he was allowed to keep it.
We would like you to access this individual's computer and delete this information. It is likely to be stored in a single archive file without backup copies.
Thankyou, -#CLIENT#
